cases.title: Does Elderwood seven earn two slots?
cases.question: For an Ezreal board, what am I really getting by going from 5 to 7 Elderwood? Is the extra plant worth replacing Shen and Taric with Xayah and LeBlanc, or am I giving up too much useful frontline?
cases.origin: Adapted Ezreal discussion need; exact package retained from approved proposal.
cases.comparison: Eight units: Ornn, Alistar, Hecarim, Ezreal, Gnar, Kennen plus Shen/Taric versus Xayah/LeBlanc.
unresolved_evidence: Comparable Elderwood stars and item allocation

cases.title: Inferno splash versus Executioner
cases.question: Can Inferno Lux be worth a slot just for the 2 Inferno splash? On this Ezreal board I'd have to drop Kennen and lose Executioner.
cases.origin: Approved constructed Ezreal substitution motivated by Lux slot-value discussion.
cases.comparison: Eight units: Ornn, Alistar, Hecarim, Ezreal, Gnar, Alune, Taric plus Kennen1 versus confirmed Inferno Lux1.

cases.title: Solar compression after five three-stars
cases.question: For finished Akali–Camille reroll boards with Akali, Camille, Varus, Leona and Ornn all three-star, do Solar Lux plus Maokai outperform keeping two-star Kayle and Sejuani, or is the apparent upgrade just richer boards doing better?
cases.origin: New adaptation of independently opened Solar rebuttals and Avatar replies.
cases.comparison: Eight units share Akali3, Camille3, Varus3, Leona3, Ornn3, Taric1; Kayle2/Sejuani2 versus Solar Lux1/Maokai1.

cases.title: Eclipse without reroll investment
cases.question: On nine-unit Lunar endboards with no three-star units, does spending two slots on Solar Lux and Sejuani for Eclipse beat using Taric and Maokai instead?
cases.origin: New adaptation of Eclipse-versus-Solar disagreement; exact packages constructed.
cases.comparison: Nine units share Alune1, Aphelios2, Diana2, Amumu2, Shen2, Kennen1, Gnar2; Solar Lux1/Sejuani2 versus Taric1/Maokai1.
unresolved_evidence: Verified Eclipse and Solar Lux representation

cases.title: Keeping seven Inferno on finished boards
cases.question: For completed nine-unit Inferno Lux boards, is keeping seven Inferno actually better than five with Taric and Maokai, when the units removed are unitemized two-star Akali and Varus?
cases.origin: New adaptation of seven-to-five reply and disagreement about vertical strength.
cases.comparison: Nine units share Shen2, Amumu2, Kennen2, Inferno Lux2, Alune1, Ezreal2, Gnar2; Akali2/Varus2 versus Taric1/Maokai1.
unresolved_evidence: Prior economic value is not recoverable from endboards

cases.title: Fae four with compressed support slots
cases.question: For three-star Tristana endboards with a Fae emblem on Sett, does replacing two-star Rakan and Xayah with one-star Fae Lux and Taric improve results while keeping four Fae? Does that still hold when Rakan and Xayah are both three-star?
cases.origin: New adaptation of Fae compression claim and its three-star exception; Sett anchor constructed.
cases.comparison: Eight units share Tristana3, Rammus2, Kobuko2, Veigar2, Gnar2, Sett2 with Fae emblem; Rakan2/Xayah2 versus Fae Lux1/Taric1. Separate Rakan3/Xayah3 retention stratum.
